title: Physics
description: ICSE Class IX Physics: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks internal assessment of practical work. SI units are used throughout.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Physics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' and Jagran Josh 2026-27 reproductions.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Measurements and Experimentation; Motion in One Dimension; Laws of Motion; Fluids; Heat and Energy; Light; Sound; Electricity and Magnetism.

sections.title: Physics
sections.description: Eight units from measurement to electricity and magnetism.

chapters.title: Measurements and Experimentation
chapters.blurb: SI units, Vernier callipers, screw gauge, simple pendulum and T = 2π√(l/g).

chapters.title: Motion in One Dimension
chapters.blurb: Scalars, vectors, graphs, and the equations of uniformly accelerated motion.

chapters.title: Laws of Motion
chapters.blurb: Contact and non-contact forces, Newton's three laws, momentum, gravitation.

chapters.title: Fluids
chapters.blurb: Pressure with depth, Pascal's law, atmospheric pressure, Archimedes' principle and floatation.

chapters.title: Heat and Energy
chapters.blurb: Heat vs temperature, anomalous expansion of water, energy sources.

chapters.title: Reflection of Light
chapters.blurb: Laws of reflection, plane mirrors and spherical mirrors with ray diagrams.

chapters.title: Propagation of Sound Waves
chapters.blurb: Production and propagation, wavelength, frequency, amplitude, echo and reverberation.

chapters.title: Current Electricity
chapters.blurb: Current, potential, Ohm's law, resistance and simple circuits.

chapters.title: Magnetism
chapters.blurb: Induction by bar magnets, magnetic properties and compass behaviour.
